# Optimity Technologies — Operations-First Engineering for SMEs and Mid-Market Companies

> We build and deploy the systems your business actually needs. Operations-first engineering for SME and mid-market companies: software, AI, and integrations that go into production.

Optimity Technologies is a team of senior engineers and architects working across India, the USA, and the UAE. We work directly inside a customer's operation: understand how the business actually runs, build the missing software/AI/integration layer, connect the tools already in use, and deploy it into production. No rip-and-replace.

## What we do

- **Workflow automation**: software that does the multi-step work teams do by hand — reading from the ERP, writing to the CRM, moving the order along without retyping.
- **Document intelligence**: contracts, invoices, referrals, and manuals read into structured, searchable records that staff approve instead of retype.
- **Decision support**: the morning questions answered before they're asked — what's about to go wrong, which account needs a call, what to reorder.
- **Compliance & audit**: continuous checks against a company's own rules and regulations, with an auditable trail.

Built on the systems companies already run: NetSuite, SAP, Dynamics 365, Salesforce, HubSpot, Shopify, POS systems, EHRs, accounting software, and the spreadsheets in between.

## How we work

- [How We Work](https://optimitytechnologies.com/how-we-work.html): operations-first method — **Understand, Build, Operate**. We learn how the business actually runs before deciding what to build; we build on the existing stack or build AI-native; we deploy into production and stay to improve it.
- [The Operations Teardown](https://optimitytechnologies.com/contact.html#book): the free first step — a working look at where AI and software change an outcome in a specific operation, and where they don't. No deck, no pitch.

## Who it's for

- [Industries](https://optimitytechnologies.com/industries.html): SME and mid-market companies (roughly 50–500 people). Sector focus: logistics & distribution, retail & e-commerce, manufacturing, healthcare, real estate, professional services. The tools differ by sector; the friction — systems that don't talk, people carrying data by hand — repeats.

## Ways of working

- [Why Optimity](https://optimitytechnologies.com/why-optimity.html): not a dev shop, not a consultancy — we deploy. Clients own what we build; systems are built into the existing stack; AI only where it changes an outcome. Three engagement models:
  - **Product Studio**: we build and run the whole thing, from discovery to a system the team uses daily.
  - **Embedded Teams**: senior engineers working inside the client's team, on their tools, at their cadence.
  - **Strategic Advisory**: architecture reviews, build-vs-buy decisions, fractional CTO work.

## Company & contact

- [About Us](https://optimitytechnologies.com/about.html): builders first, advisors where it helps — one team does the understanding, building, and deploying.
- [Contact & Book a Teardown](https://optimitytechnologies.com/contact.html): direct booking or `contact@optimitytechnologies.com`.
